mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, reducing present values and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level as a predictor of 20-day returns is negative and statistically significant (p<0.05) in less than 60% of 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1400, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%), the positive impact of low unemployment on equity returns is amplified, leading to higher forward returns compared to other regimes.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (FEDFUNDS>5.0 and UNRATE<4.0), the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The negative effect of high monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) on equity returns is amplified when inflation is elevated (CPIAUCSL > 300), creating a 'higher for longer' environment that suppresses valuations.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns are not observed when both series are above thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 102 signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 102, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 680,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 680000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 156,000 thousand persons) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS > 156000, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
